Tuesday Shop Ride (Blue Wheel Bicycles)

Charlottesville, VA · Mountain bike

Beginner friendly

Tuesday Shop Ride (Blue Wheel Bicycles) is a mountain bike group ride in Charlottesville, VA. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:15 pm. Pace: two groups: Shred (fast) and Social (gentle, beginner-friendly).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: two groups: Shred (fast) and Social (gentle, beginner-friendly). It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Shop Ride (Blue Wheel Bicycles) group ride

A local mountain bike ride led by shop staff. Two groups: Shred goes fast, Social keeps it gentle and welcomes beginners. Meets at one of three trailheads each week; the shop posts the location on its website banner. Off the trails by dark. Riders under 14 need an adult.
